name: v1.7.4
body:
## What's Changed
* Fix URL parsing for self-hosted instances. by @rauaap in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3472
* fix: correct changelog links and preserve line breaks by @nyxiereal in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3471
* Translation: Update ru.json by @solokot in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3463
* Translation: Update hu.json by @summoner001 in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3462
* Complete Simplified Chinese translations and clarify certificate prompts by @HotKids in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3460
* Add a per-app install method setting by @bercedev in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3457
* By @ImranR98 in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3479
    * Fall back to dart:io when Android memory DCL is restricted (#3442)
    * Fix signing certificate checks on Android 9 and 10 (#3475)
    * Prefer the ABI-specific APK when the saved choice is universal (#3473)
    * Remove the defunct APKCombo source (#3468)

## New Contributors
* @rauaap made their first contribution in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3472
* @nyxiereal made their first contribution in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3471

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/compare/v1.7.3...v1.7.4
